paragraphs.text: Chada was a sergeant in the kentsu .

He came from the Empire of Madara and had some trouble following orders from the vicious Ærathi Commander Gunamo . Chada was the only survivor of the soldiers that attacked the Sylvan Library . When Ayesha Tanaka gave the kentsu the decision to run or to fight, Chada was one of the few who ran, and thus one of the few who survived.
